text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: The Arima Kinen is finally here.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
As predicted, Narita Brian is<n>competing. The morning
news is<n>calling this the "sister showdown of<n>the
century."

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Of course, the victor of said<n>showdown will
obviously be me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Time for me to go. I have a promise to<n>keep with
Brian.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I can't even remember the last time<n>we raced each
other.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
You're strong now, Brian. You're the<n>strongest
Triple Crown Champion<n>ever, in fact. No wonder
they call you<n>the Beast.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
But if you're "the beast," what does<n>that make me
as your big sister?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I forged the path that brought you<n>here today. Don't
think for a second<n>you're leaving here with the win.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: And catch me if you can!
